caption_L1: This is a line graph named Number of Hispanic families with a single mother in the U.S. from 1990 to 2019 (in 1,000s). The y-axis measures Families in thousands using a linear scale of range 0 to 3,500. A linear scale of range 1990 to 2015 can be seen on the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: Since 1990 there has been a steady increase up until about 2014. From 2014 the increase appears to level out and stay about the same.
